import 'package:blot_effect/blot_effect.dart';
sealed class AppError {}
final class NetworkError extends AppError {}
final class ParseError extends AppError {}
final class Services {
  final String endpoint;
  Services(this.endpoint);
}
void main() {
  final Effect<int, AppError, Services> first = Effect.fail<int, AppError, Services>(NetworkError());
  final Effect<String, AppError, Services> composed = first.flatMap((n) => Effect.fail<String, AppError, Services>(ParseError()));
  final Effect<String, AppError, Services> recovered = composed.catchAll((e) => Effect.succeed<String, AppError, Services>('fallback'));
  final Effect<String, AppError, Services> service = Effect.environment<String, AppError, Services>((s) => s.endpoint);
  final runtime = Runtime(Services('local'));
  runtime.runExit(recovered);
  runtime.runExit(service);
}
